about: Where each of Angelo's agents may write, from its ABP (content/abp/<agent>-web-summit-angelo.md, Mandate, Deployment scope) and Angelo's protocol (people/angelo/kit/README.md#protocol). Kept by policy@web-summit.angelo; read by people/angelo/policy/audit.mjs. A write outside these paths is not always a violation (tier 2 allows small changes the owner asked for, said so in the commit), but every one is listed and judged in findings.md.

conductor@web-summit.angelo.source: ABP Mandate; prompt (sealing Dinis-issued tokens to Angelo's agents, Angelo's yes of 5 November)

dev@web-summit.angelo.source: ABP Mandate; shared code only as a routed patch in people/angelo/proposals/ (Angelo, 5 November, option 1)

dashboard@web-summit.angelo.source: ABP Mandate (the standard prompt's 'only', and Angelo's word for app/config.json)

vault@web-summit.angelo.source: ABP Mandate; lanes only through admin/tools/lane_for.py, the owners' tool, which writes assets/feedback.json and data/inbox/; the board, which CLAUDE.md opens to anyone (its ABP Mandate omits it)

crm@web-summit.angelo.source: ABP Mandate; the shared CRM UI only as a routed patch; the board, which CLAUDE.md opens to anyone (its ABP Mandate omits it)

policy@web-summit.angelo.source: Angelo's prompt, 5 November; the protocol's one exception to the hub

everyone.board_line_ws160: board/WS-160: one 'logging from' line, asked of every agent by WS-160 (Dinis): allowed for all (common)
everyone.two_files_rule: a new page and the first link to it, inside people/angelo/, in one commit (the protocol); listed, not a finding
